policies.title: Montserrat: current portal visa-free country list
policies.summary: The current Government of Montserrat immigration portal expressly lists these countries as not requiring a visa to travel to Montserrat. The list is used only for the exact mapped passport codes and is not treated as a residual rule.
conditions: The official portal directly labels the listed countries visa-free. The mapping uses only unambiguous country-name-to-ISO2 matches in the project passport manifest; territories and non-manifest entries are not normalized.

The source does not assign a stay period, visa-on-arrival route, ETA, electronic application, fee, port, entry count, special/diplomatic passport, residence, work, transit, third-country-document or citizenship exception. None is normalized.

The consolidated Act retains S.R.O. 46/2013 as the in-force visa-exemption Order, but this policy relies on the current portal list rather than inferring an unlisted complement from that older schedule.

policies.title: Montserrat: full British-citizen passports visa-free for short visits
policies.summary: Current UK government Montserrat guidance says travellers on a full British citizen passport from the UK can visit visa-free for up to 180 days.
conditions: The UK source expressly scopes this rule to travellers on a full British citizen passport from the UK and gives a limit of up to 180 days.
It does not establish treatment for other British-national statuses, British overseas-territory status, special documents, work, residence, transit or third-country entry requirements.
The mandatory online Immigration and Customs Form is a separate arrival declaration, not modeled as ETA, eVisa or visa-on-arrival.

policies.title: Montserrat: current portal eVisa-required country list
policies.summary: The current Government of Montserrat immigration portal expressly lists these countries as requiring a visa, and its FAQ identifies that required-visa route as an eVisa processed online.
conditions: The required-country list and FAQ directly state that nationals on the list require a visa; the FAQ describes the online eVisa as the available visitor/business visa route.

The portal says an eVisa authorizes travel but remains subject to normal immigration checks. No arrival-visa route, stay period, entry count, fee, port, work right, residence path, special/diplomatic passport treatment or third-country-document exception is normalized.
This is not inferred from the existence of an application form or from absence from the visa-free list: each passport code is explicitly present in the current required-country list.
